---
title: "WER_Plot"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

df <- bind_rows(
  read_csv("results.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(group = "Group 1"),
  read_csv("results_1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(group = "Group 2")
)
```

```{r}
summary <- df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    ref_words = sum(ref_words),
    errors = sum(substitutions + deletions + insertions),
    pooled_wer = errors / ref_words
  )

write_csv(df, "results_combined.csv")
```

```{r}
# Prepare data for the plot
plot_data <- df %>%
  mutate(file = factor(file, levels = file[order(wer)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(substitutions, deletions, insertions),
    names_to = "error_type",
    values_to = "errors"
  ) %>%
  mutate(rate = errors / ref_words)

# Plot WER by recording
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = rate, y = file, fill = error_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    substitutions = "#E69F00",
    deletions = "#56B4E9",
    insertions = "#CC79A7"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Whisper Word Error Rate by Recording",
    x = "Errors as % of reference words",
    y = "Recording",
    fill = "Error Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave("wer_by_file_groups.png", width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
